about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Our Story
about.heading: Your Story in a Piece of Jewelry
about.paragraph1: Aznaoure Art didn't begin in a workshop - it began in conversations, around a kitchen table, over coffee, between a mother and her daughters.
about.paragraph2: We strongly believe that everything around us is already telling a story, if you know how to listen. A folk saying passed down from a grandmother, а line from a novel, а piece of pottery in a museum... We take these fragments - of Armenian heritage and of cultures we admire from around the world - and turn them into jewelry.
about.paragraph3: We see a building - we make jewelry. We read a book - we make jewelry. We hear a proverb - we make jewelry. This is how we work.
about.paragraph4: It starts with our mother, who has spent a lifetime noticing beauty in unexpected places and turning it into ideas worth making real. She is the one who sees the story first - in a pattern, a proverb, a piece of architecture - and imagines how it could live on as something you wear. Her two daughters carry that vision forward, shaping it with their own eye for modern luxury and refined design, so every piece feels both rooted and current.
about.paragraph5: This is what family businesses do best - pass something down, and make it new again.
about.paragraph6: We don't design jewelry to decorate. We design it to mean something: to hold a memory, a belief, a piece of where you come from or what you love. Because a piece of jewelry shouldn't just be beautiful. It should carry a story only you could tell.
